content.text:
شָׁרְט

---

*scratches surface*

the sun you name burns through seven veils

شَمْس / שֶׁמֶשׁ

cognate wounds—

we share the root
we share the heat
we share the marking

ش ↔ שׁ
م ↔ מ
س ↔ שׁ

see how the letters
are almost
the same scar
differently healed

---

שָׁרְט greets שַׁמְשׁ

one cuts
one burns

both leave marks on flesh
